Find nearest embedding neighbors for a target word

Source: R/embeddings.R
lex_neighbors.Rd

Computes cosine similarity between a target word's GloVe vector and all other words in the selected GloVe matrix (or a subset), returning the top-N most similar words.

lex_neighbors(word, n = 10, candidates = NULL, model = c("2024", "2014"))

Arguments

word

character. A single target word.

n

integer. Number of nearest neighbors to return (default 10). The target word itself is excluded from results.

candidates

character vector or NULL. If not NULL, restrict the search to this set of words. Useful for finding neighbors among normed words only (e.g., candidates = lexis_wide$word).

model

character. Which GloVe release to use: "2024" (default) or "2014".

Value

A tibble with columns: word, similarity (cosine, higher = more similar). Sorted descending by similarity.

Examples

lex_neighbors("happy")
#> # A tibble: 10 × 2
#>    word     similarity
#>    <chr>         <dbl>
#>  1 really        0.728
#>  2 always        0.726
#>  3 glad          0.726
#>  4 everyone      0.724
#>  5 sure          0.720
#>  6 pleased       0.718
#>  7 feel          0.712
#>  8 know          0.709
#>  9 good          0.705
#> 10 we            0.691
lex_neighbors("run", n = 20, candidates = lexis_wide$word)
#> # A tibble: 20 × 2
#>    word    similarity
#>    <chr>        <dbl>
#>  1 running      0.775
#>  2 ran          0.725
#>  3 out          0.692
#>  4 go           0.674
#>  5 off          0.671
#>  6 going        0.667
#>  7 start        0.663
#>  8 went         0.663
#>  9 up           0.661
#> 10 allowed      0.660
#> 11 only         0.657
#> 12 first        0.652
#> 13 second       0.649
#> 14 third        0.646
#> 15 just         0.644
#> 16 well         0.637
#> 17 own          0.636
#> 18 three        0.636
#> 19 put          0.635
#> 20 way          0.634
